home.rulesBody: Custom shipping rates are on the way. Rules, rate tables and the cart simulator will appear here.
home.testModeBody: Add sugarship to the shipping address at checkout to see Sugar Ship test rates. Real customers won't see them.

zones.title: Zones
zones.noRestOfWorldBody: Addresses outside your zones won't get Sugar Ship rates. Add a Rest of world zone to cover them.
zones.emptyBody: Zones group the countries and states you ship to, like India or Europe. You'll set a price for each zone when you create a rate.
zones.restOfWorldHelp: Covers every country and state that isn't in another zone.
zones.restOfWorldTaken: {{zone}} is already your Rest of world zone.
zones.deleteBody: This zone will be deleted. This can't be undone.
zones.deleteBodyRates_one: This zone and its {{count}} rate will be deleted. This can't be undone.
zones.deleteBodyRates_other: This zone and its {{count}} rates will be deleted. This can't be undone.
zones.errorsTitle: Fix these to save the zone
zones.errorStatesRequired: Choose at least one state for {{country}}.
zones.errorRestOfWorldExists: {{zone}} is already your Rest of world zone.
zones.errorInvalid: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

rates.title: Rates
rates.emptyBody: Choose what customers pay to ship to each of your zones, for example a flat price at home and a higher one abroad. You can add rules like free shipping over an amount later.
rates.noZonesHeading: Add a zone before you set rates
rates.noZonesBody: Rates are priced per zone, so first tell Sugar Ship which countries and states you ship to.
rates.activeHelp: Inactive rates are never shown at checkout.
rates.customNameHelp: Shown exactly as typed, in every language.
rates.pricesHelp: Leave a zone empty to not offer this rate there. Enter 0 for free shipping.
rates.deleteBody: Customers will no longer see this rate. This can't be undone.
rates.errorsTitle: Fix these to save the rate
rates.errorCustomNameRequired: Enter the name customers will see.
rates.errorDaysInvalid: Delivery days must be whole numbers from 0 to 365.
rates.errorPricesRequired: Enter a price for at least one zone.
rates.errorZoneUnknown: A zone in this rate no longer exists. Reload the page.
rates.errorZoneDuplicate: A zone in this rate no longer exists. Reload the page.
rates.errorInvalid: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
rates.errorConditionUnsupported: Condition {{number}} can't be used here. Remove it and add it again.
rates.errorConditionWeightInvalid: Condition {{number}}: enter a weight in kg, with up to 3 decimals.
rates.errorConditionQuantityInvalid: Condition {{number}}: enter a whole number of items.
rates.quantityHelp: Counts each unit, e.g. 2 T-shirts + 1 cap = 3.
